description.p: Lemuri is a free, open-source, lightweight desktop SSH client for managing servers and VPS, featuring host trees, split terminals, SFTP transfers, live metrics, an encrypted vault, backups, and secure team sharing.

ul.li: Servers in folders, with disk usage, pending updates, reboots needed and an SSH security check
Shells in tabs and split panes, synced typing, jump hosts checked against known_hosts
Files over SFTP from the terminal: drop to upload, right click a name to download
An encrypted vault for passwords (AES-GCM, Argon2id)
Hosts shared with your team, sealed and signed, as text or over the local network
Encrypted backups, import of ~/.ssh/config, a see-through ghost terminal

screenshot.caption: Hosts in folders and a split terminal

description.p: Fixes: the texts after an update, a crash in a terminal scrolled back, ghost mode on a screen without panels.
A shaded backdrop with waves, the server's name and a close button over each terminal, Lemuri in the GNOME dock.
